pain_points: Manual fuel charge calculations costing you money?

features.title: Complete Audit Trail & Legal Protection
features.subtitle: Never lose a dispute again
features.description: Every contract change is tracked with timestamps, user names, edit reasons, and before/after snapshots. Finalized contracts become immutable - no unauthorized edits possible.
benefits: Complete legal compliance with full audit trails
Track who did what, when, and why
features.impact: Reduce disputes by 80% with complete documentation

features.title: Automatic Financial Calculations
features.subtitle: Stop losing money on calculation errors
features.description: Fuel charges automatically calculated based on tank capacity, fuel type, and market prices. Extra charges, late penalties, VAT - all computed accurately in seconds.
benefits: Zero calculation errors - no more money left on the table
Automatic fuel charges: (Tank Capacity × Fuel % Used × Price Per Liter)
Extra mileage, damages, and addon fees - all tracked
features.impact: Save 2-3 hours per contract + recover 100% of fuel costs

features.title: Professional Bilingual Support

features.description: Complete English and Arabic interface with automatic RTL/LTR switching. Professional PDF contracts in both languages. Built specifically for the UAE market.
benefits: Full Arabic interface with proper RTL layout
Material Design 3 with Arabic typography (Cairo font)
Seamless language switching for staff and customers
features.impact: Serve both Arabic and English-speaking customers professionally
